title: Reborn as a Barrier Master
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A 34-year-old worker at an exploitative company wakes in another world as a six-year-old slave with a weak barrier skill. Bought and renamed Linus, he is raised as a noble household's Barrier Master and trains hard while court politics, including a coup, close in (Seven Seas blurb via AniList; ANN Manga Guide).
life_message: Hard work and the kindness of a protector can lift someone out of bondage into a useful, secure life.

content.note: Dangerous quests and a coup (ANN); MU Death of Loved One/s, Child Abuse; AniList Slavery rank 79.
